retrievalProfile.description: A mid-century mixed-media style featuring painterly yellow suns, gestural landscape strokes, and layered condensed typography with overprint effects.
triggerTerms: warm yellow and ochre gouache textures
excludeWhen: dark or neon color palettes are needed

recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, gestural composition combining loose gouache painting of a radiant sun and rural landscape with structured, layered condensed typography that mimics the look of offset lithography and screen printing.
coreVisualRelationships: Radiant circular sun motifs anchoring the upper right quadrant
Diagonal gestural brushstrokes defining a receding landscape plane
Layered, semi-transparent typography interacting with background textures
A central figure with a guitar integrated into the lower right landscape
coreInvariants: Dominant warm yellow and ochre color palette

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The sun is a large, dominant element in the upper right; the human figure is smaller, grounded in the lower right foreground.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, textured yellow sun in the top right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the sun down the diagonal landscape line to the figure, then back up through the layered text blocks.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Significant white space on the left side balances the dense, textured elements on the right.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Warm Yellows and Ochres (Sun and light)
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep Browns and Blacks (Landscape outlines and primary text)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted Blue-Grey and Orange (Secondary text and shadows)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the yellows contrasted against high-value white space and low-value dark ink strokes.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying scales and colors of the same condensed sans-serif family to create depth.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy weight and condensed nature of the primary display type.
Captures the extreme verticality and tight spacing of the 1960s aesthetic.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a mixed-media painting on a white background. In the upper right, paint a large, radiant sun using concentric circles of yellow gouache and textured orange ink. Draw a diagonal landscape from the center-left to the bottom-right using gestural brown ink strokes and washes of ochre. Include small, simplified figures of sheep and a man with a guitar in the lower right, integrated into the brushwork.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add uppercase text using an extra-condensed heavy sans-serif font. Place a large orange block of text in the center-right, and a smaller blue-grey version slightly offset below it to create a layered, overprinted effect. Add smaller black text horizontally across the center.

verificationChecks: Is the sun the primary visual anchor in the top right?
Does the typography use a heavy, condensed sans-serif?
Is there a clear diagonal movement in the landscape strokes?
Are the colors limited to a warm, mid-century palette?

adjustableVariables: Transparency level of the overlapping text
Scale of the sun relative to the canvas

mustAchieve: Hand-painted texture in the sun and landscape
Balanced use of negative white space
avoid: Cluttered left-hand side of the composition

postGenerationChecks: Check for visible brushstroke textures in the yellow areas.
Ensure the text feels integrated with the background through layering.
Verify the diagonal composition leads the eye toward the figure.
Confirm the typography is strictly uppercase and condensed.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a textured gouache sun and gestural ink landscape with layered, extra-condensed sans-serif display type to evoke a 1960s folk aesthetic.
